task.description:
Design the following four requirements for Batch F2c. Classify per lego-catalog.md:

1. **PD-09 (backend, SHOULD)** — Definition import/export: GET /definitions/{id}/export and POST /definitions/import endpoints. Export returns self-contained JSON with bpm_export_schema_version. Import creates new DRAFT with new UUID. Validate graph on import.

2. **PD-10 (backend, COULD)** — Definition search: GET /definitions/search?q={query} with full-text search, ranked results, case-insensitive, partial word matching.

3. **PD-UI-07 (frontend, SHOULD)** — Export button on definition editor, Import button on definition list view.

4. **PD-UI-08 (frontend, COULD)** — Debounced search bar on definition list, querying PD-10 endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers API signatures, request/response shapes, validation rules

result.summary: Design for PD-09 (Type E), PD-10 (Type A), PD-UI-07 (Type E), PD-UI-08 (Type E)
